The y-axis range shown in the chart is from 0 to 50, not 30 to 50.

errors.text_span: с единици в минути на час
errors.evidence: The y-axis label is "Общо работни часове на седмица" (Total work hours per week). The units are hours, not "минути на час" (minutes per hour).
The y-axis is labeled with major ticks at intervals of 10 hours (10, 20, 30, 40, 50), not 5.

errors.text_span: сините стълбове представляват мъжете и показва стойности приблизително между 41,85 и 44,33, като най-високата стойност е 44,33 в Унгария
errors.evidence: This is incorrect. The actual range for men (blue bars) is from 37.64 (Finland) to 45.64 (Czechia). The highest value is 45.64 in Czechia, not 44.33 in Hungary.

errors.text_span: Кралството на Обединеното кралство има най-ниската стойност 43.13
errors.evidence: The chart does not include data for the United Kingdom. The value 43.13 corresponds to men in Slovakia.

errors.text_span: Червените стълбове представляват жените и показват стойности между 37,64 и 45,64 средно
errors.evidence: This is incorrect. The actual range for women (red bars) is from 34.9 (Finland) to 43.54 (Czechia). The stated range uses values from the men's data series.
The highest value for women is 43.54 in Czechia. The value 45.64 belongs to men in Czechia, and the value for women in Estonia is 39.61.
The lowest value for women is 34.9 in Finland. The value 37.64 belongs to men in Finland, and the value for women in Slovakia is 40.4.

errors.text_span: данните показват малко разлики в средните часове
errors.evidence: Describing the differences between men's and women's working hours as "малко" (small) is a subjective interpretation and not an objective description of the data. For example, the difference in France is over 5 hours (42.13 vs 37).
The data values are explicitly labeled on each bar to two decimal places; they are not approximate.
